sources.facts: 5IN1 variant includes serial 2.4 GHz ELRS, analog VTX, a 1S 5A ESC and SH1.0 four-pin service. Mount pitch 26 × 26 mm. Manufacturer describes 0.8 mm board construction. Four 4 mm screws, four shock balls, antennas, battery pigtail and external service parts in kit. Motor wiring is solder-only.
Supplier identifies the Air 5IN1 FC/ESC/OSD/VTX/RX version. Confirm the MPN on the item or packaging.
sources.availability: Supplier page reported 11 units in a four-day-old capture. Confirm at order.

sources.facts: Analog NTSC camera, 3–5.5 V, JST-0.8 lead. Product dimensions 11 × 15 × 14 mm. Use its linked V2 drawing when assessing an actual sample.
One 4-pack. Three M1.4 motor mounts on Ø6.6 mm circle, 1 mm shaft, 4.2 mm exposed shaft. 1S, 35 mm connector lead. Kit includes twelve M1.4 × 3 mm metal screws and fifteen PEEK alternatives.
Supplier matches the specific MPN and four-motor pack. Check international shipping to destination.
sources.availability: Supplier page indicated stock in a month-old capture. Confirm at order.

54 × 11 × 6.5 mm, BT2.0, one LiHV cell, 3.8 V nominal. Store pack contains five cells.

sources.availability: Product page lists stock. Length-specific fulfillment unverified.

Select the 2.4 GHz ExpressLRS version. Check installed ELRS major versions and region on both ends.
Bench display candidate with 5.8 GHz analog receive capability. Confirm band/channel with the selected FC and any existing receiver.
Single-cell BT2.0 candidate, 4.35 V / 1 A rated output. Confirm the received 260 mAh pack permits this charge current, or select a suitable adjustable charger.
Example workshop printer family. Confirm the installed 0.4 mm nozzle and the PETG profile. Existing suitable printers may be used.
Driver option for a workshop tool set. Match actual screw recesses. Supply calipers, flush cutters and tweezers separately if needed.
Example meter with voltage and continuity functions. Existing appropriate meter and leads can serve this bench role.

Lead-free solder wire option. Allocate only the amount used.
Example no-clean flux pen for electronics. Check process compatibility.

sources.facts: Adjustable current. BT2.0, 1S LiHV, 4.35 V option. Standard model calls for suitable USB-C PD input power. The published current table starts at 280 mAh. Verify an appropriate setting for the actual 260 mAh pack.

interfaces: STEP readback: 26.00 mm pitch, original 0.95 mm. Revised 0.80 mm with Z bottom 3.50 mm and top 4.30 mm.
Revised source and one clean rebuild pass. Measure actual PCB outline, connector overlap and seated damping rubber.
11 × 15 × 14 mm package, 3–5.5 V analog NTSC, JST-0.8 lead.
Camera-axis STEP measurement: 11.00 × 15.00 × 14.00 mm. Modeled PCB 11 × 0.84 × 14 mm.
Dimensions align nominally. Check lens, retention and harness pin order against the actual V2 camera.
3 M1.4 on Ø6.6 mm, shaft Ø1 × 4.2 mm, 1S. Connectorized 35 mm motor leads.
STEP shaft Ø1.00 × 4.20 mm, Ø6.60 mm mounting circle. The three reference bores measure Ø1.44 mm.
FC has solder pads only. Plan physical termination and verify routing. Check 1219S motor load before flight.
31 mm sweep, 1 mm bore, two clockwise and two counterclockwise per pack.
Revised frame retains a 15.5 mm disk radius and 0.80 mm nominal disk-to-guard clearance on all four motors.
Printed and moving clearance needs bench measurement. Supplier motor guide specifies other prop examples for its test pairing.
Installed STEP bounds: 54.00 × 11.00 × 6.50 mm when ordered as length, width and height.
Measure actual pack, connector body, bend clearance and retaining-band preload.
Board kit includes 4 shock balls and four 4 mm tapping screws. Dock calls for 6 mm length.
Grip shoulder follows the revised 0.80 mm board. External grommet seating envelope and dock position are held fixed.
Compression, head diameter and tap engagement are unresolved physical values. The 6 mm cross-head is a candidate.
